request.description: Takes a version out of use immediately: a draft or pending version is discarded (its change request is withdrawn), a published one stops being served and the previous published version, if any, takes over. Retired versions are final. Publishes `config.retired`. Staff only. Question sets are versioned config: draft → submit (maker) → approve or reject (a different staff member, in Change Requests) → publish → retire. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for question sets (ops lead, super admin).
